rationale: Lycopolitan compound on ϩⲟ ('face'); functions throughout this chapter as the technical term for the four cosmic faces/personae of Light and Darkness. Equivalent to Greek πρόσωπον.

ϣⲛⲉ = ϣⲏⲛⲉ 'tree' — first item in the per-face correspondence schema. Each face's tree expresses its characteristic emanation: image of light, Wisdom of Light, etc. Fits Manichaean tree-symbolism (Tree of Life, Tree of Light).
ⲭⲁⲓ̈ = ϭⲁⲓ̈ 'figure, stature, tall extent'; the bodily-cosmic correspondent of each face: four sons / cosmos / Church / [unknown]. Distinct from ⲡⲉϩⲥⲱⲙⲁ 'his body.'

Standard Manichaean title (tertius legatus) for the third of the great cosmic envoys. Even when this entity is here listed as 'the second face,' the title 'Third Ambassador' is retained as a fixed proper title.
Greek ταμεῖον. The 'five storehouses' = the Five Light Elements that First Man wears as armor descending into the abyss. Standard Manichaean cosmological term.
Lycopolitan ϣⲓⲕ 'depth, pit' with -ϩ termination. Designates the lower cosmic region into which the Third Ambassador's image is revealed.
Apparent emphatic doubling of ⲱⲣⲉϩ (= ⲱⲣϫ/ⲱⲣϩ 'guard'). Describes First Man's commission over the five storehouses of light.
Lycopolitan causative verb of dispatching/sending; used both of the Third Ambassador sending Light upward and of Wisdom sending souls. Distinct from ⲧⲛ̄ⲛⲁⲩ.
ⲥⲁϫⲛⲉ = ϣⲟϫⲛⲉ 'counsel'; here as title of the fourth face. May denote the Light Mind, Mother of Life, or Living Spirit — uncertain without preserved continuation.
ⲕⲱⲧⲉ 'circuit, surrounding region' — designates a cosmic zone of encirclement. Distinct from the homophonous ⲕⲱⲧϩ 'pluck.'
